name: 62233 · Chester, IL
findings: ZIP 62233 (Chester) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62233 (Chester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62233 (Chester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
